summary: Extends the Layer Two Tunneling Protocol so that link-specific PPP options can be negotiated properly. Because L2TP puts a virtual link between two PPP peers, they lose direct knowledge of the physical media, and these extensions help them negotiate options suited to it.

eli5.summary: When a tunnel hides the real wire, the two ends can no longer see what kind of cable is there. This note adds a way to pass that information along so they can still agree on settings.
